title.narrative: WCO - Anti-corruption and integiry promotion in customs, (A-CIP) phase 3

description.narrative:
The WCO A-CIP Programme has become the WCO’s flagship for integrity-related support to its Members. The Programme aims at improving the business and law enforcement environment for cross-border trade in WCO Member countries by helping them make changes to the operational and administrative context that restricts corrupt behaviour and promotes good governance in Customs services.
The WCO will support WCO Members in their fight against corruption. The Programme stand alongside other national and global efforts to provide systemic change that transforms structures, customs, mindsets, power dynamics and policies which will increase national DRM and strengthen the ecosystem of national integrity. The WCO A-CIP Programme provides the material and human resources, technical assistance and capacity building tools necessary to make this happen.
